reference_instructions: Read all evidence references inside this state; no local path is retrievable. In a description_provenance object, same_as names one full record in repair_input_shared_evidence. Merge that record with literal overrides, which replace whole fields. A reference is used only where the original complete key set is recoverable. Every differing value remains literal. In history observations, same_as_current names the exact check/test/assertion observation in this state; literal overrides preserve every changed or extra value. These references preserve prior failures, including failures that are now resolved. They do not make a historical failure current or turn a not-reached assertion into a failure. All original requirements and all legal artifact/owner choices remain in their normal fields.
source_evidence_instructions: Recovery source evidence contains verified excerpts from current candidate artifact snapshots. Owner routing receives actual import, public signature and export boundary lines; other inspected function bodies are not visible to that owner decision. Repair selection and implementation workers receive the complete selected source ranges. Read the inline text and line ranges, not a presumed external file. Declared dependency, literal import and symbol-use relationships are hypotheses, not fault proof. Reading adds no write authority. A selected artifact with no byte change and the same failing observation requires a new supported investigation or different legal scope; selecting the same worker or profile alone is not progress.
relevance_instructions: Some description diagnostics are explicitly summarized as resolved_observation_summary. The controller verified the same current artifact revisions, a passed public case, a matching resolved prior failure, and known assertion requirements disjoint from current failures, causal paths and newly inspected source artifacts. The prior check/test/assertion, error and message remain inline; the detailed resolved description diagnostic is retained only in controller proof. This is a semantic relevance projection, not lossless model input. Unknown, not-reached, current or related failure facts are never summarized this way. All public case coverage and counts remain unchanged.

source_collection.selection: Prioritize selected-but-unchanged artifacts when available. Select files matching public error identifiers or module leaves, then one literal import edge to their producer/consumer. Inline exact imports, signatures, return boundaries, referenced-symbol lines and enclosing branch headers. Omitted function bodies remain in the immutable source, never assumed model-readable. Record every selected range and excluded file; use no numeric token or byte truncation.

recovery.source_coverage_hash_basis: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(projection report), including its integrity_sha256
recovery.source_evidence_is_new_only_when: Current verified inline facts differ from the previous recovery evidence; timestamp, path-pointer-only and model/profile changes do not count.
